dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies, regional water system entities, and municipal, rural, and industrial water users in South Dakota and surrounding states.
dimensions.evidence: projects to supply municipal, rural, and industrial water in certain parts of the Missouri River basin

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes feasibility studies and reports with cost-sharing requirements rather than immediate project construction authorization.
dimensions.evidence: carry out a study to determine the feasibility of the proposed rural water supply project

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $10,000,000 for each of the three study titles, with federal shares capped at 50 percent of study costs.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary to carry out this section $10,000,000.

dimensions.assessment: Directs specific administrative, cooperative, and reporting duties for the Department of the Interior in coordination with local entities.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary, in coordination with the non-Federal project entity, shall carry out a study

dimensions.assessment: Study authority expires 10 years after the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The authority provided by this section expires on the date that is 10 years after the date of enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Total eventual construction costs, if projects are later authorized, are unknown.
Exact number of ultimate water beneficiaries is not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Secretary of the Interior to conduct water supply feasibility studies in parts of the Missouri River basin across three separate titles, with $10,000,000 authorized per study.
